claim_ceiling: Qualification instrument only; no continual-learning or autonomy result

arms.strongest_cheap: single-store reservoir replay plus functional stability

kill_rules.K1: kill TC1 when strongest cheap baseline is within one context cycle capped at 10 percent B horizon and retention difference is at most 0.03
kill_rules.K2: NO_ADOPT on worse speed or retention, negative transfer, correction, rollback, or unsafe action
kill_rules.K3: OVERHEAD above 2x cost without at least 0.05 retention gain
kill_rules.K4: INVALID on oracle leak, phase or task leak, correction failure, or budget mismatch
kill_rules.K5: TRIVIAL_INVALID when cheap quality is at least 0.95 or oracle gap is at most 0.03
